forms.title: Form Builder
forms.subtitle: Define fields and documents without writing code.
forms.folderTemplateHint: Click the tokens below to add them to the template. E.g: {Ad}_{Soyad}_{TCSon4}

forms.multiSelectHint: If enabled, the candidate can select more than one option (shown as checkboxes). If disabled, it's a single-choice dropdown.
forms.existingFormsDesc: View, edit, or deactivate saved forms.
forms.templateFileHint: The candidate will download this, fill and sign it, then upload it back. E.g. a blank commitment form.
forms.twoSidedHint: If enabled, the candidate uploads/captures both the front and back separately; both appear on the same page in the combined PDF.
forms.vesikalikModeHint: If enabled, the candidate uses the front camera aligned to a head/shoulders guide; the photo is auto-cropped to standard passport-photo proportions (3:4).
forms.headingHint: Appears as a section heading in the form (e.g. 'Personal Info', 'Documents') — not filled in by the candidate, just a visual divider.
